question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a competitor for Semiconductor without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, the evidence must directly connect the specific R&S VNA configuration, the specific competitor model/configuration, the semiconductor use case or customer context, and the measured performance under stated test conditions; the current passages show some semiconductor-adjacent VNA cases, but they also state many missing items such as competitor specs, R&S configuration details, DUT, calibration, fixture, probe, de-embedding workflow, and measurement conditions.[13][15][31][32][34][49][52]
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | What the passages currently show |
|---|---|---|
| Specific R&S VNA model, configuration, options, order numbers, and formal specification source | R&S VNA specifications must be taken from formal product specifications, and specifications/typical/measured values have different warranty status; non-traceable, typical, nominal, and measured values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz.[2][64][89] | Formal R&S VNA sources exist for ZNA, ZNB3000, ZNL, and ZNA67EXT, with document versions and frequency ranges identified.[4][5][22][68][96] |
| Specific competitor model and configuration, not only product-family names | The Keysight ENA and PNA pages state that the sources do not list specific model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option name, or performance indicators, so they do not support performance comparison claims.[49][52] | LSmtron is the only cited case that names a competitor, Keysight ENA, but it does not provide ENA model/configuration or performance data.[31][38][49] |
| Direct evidence connecting the comparison to a semiconductor use case | The case collection says it covers VNA/probe/mount-kit/de-embedding solutions for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation measurement problems, and the sales pattern is total solution rather than a single instrument specification.[14][15] | Semiconductor-adjacent cases include AMD socket interconnection, Bare Board for SoCs with Advantest/Meritech, and Samsung 5G SoC including VCO, but each has stated limitations.[13][31][32] |
| DUT, application, and measurement items | For Bare Board for SoCs, the source lists PCB test with probing and measurement of impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, but the source does not provide DUT specifications, frequency range, probe model, or de-embedding workflow.[42][41] | For LSmtron, the DUT is Board to Board Connector and the solution is ZNB40 with probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but the source does not provide a formal ZNB40 model page, order number, frequency range, or configuration.[38][37] |
| Complete test conditions: frequency range, fixture, probe, calibration, de-embedding, measurement bandwidth, sweep settings, and environmental conditions | Formal R&S product data and accuracy depend on warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, automatic adjustments, and in some cases identical calibration/measurement frequency points, bandwidth, and sweep time.[64][89][91] | The AMD 67 GHz stability claim lacks instrument combination, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding, fixture, and DUT conditions, so it cannot be used as a standalone ZNB3044 specification.[32] |
| Measured comparison data with metric name, unit, pass/fail threshold, and test conditions | Slide 3 in the TRI case only shows “< 5” without metric name, unit, test conditions, or pass/fail threshold, so it cannot support a comparison claim.[31][32] | ZNB3000 dynamic range conditions are specified as 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, but competitor performance data with equivalent conditions is not provided.[23] |
| Competitor evidence from official datasheets or third-party sources when making customer-facing claims | The Keysight-related limitations state that R&S battle-card claims need Keysight official data or third-party evidence for customer documents, and that battle cards do not replace formal specifications/features documents.[17][34] | The Keysight page says the CMX500 battle card lacks Keysight UXM official datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions; this illustrates the same evidence gap for competitor claims.[34] |
| Clear separation of sales positioning from verified technical specifications | The CMX500 vs Keysight page says the comparison is sales positioning, not binding technical specifications, and “only platform,” “first validated,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” are sales language rather than verified technical specifications.[16][17] | For VNA cases, the stated win factor is total solution with probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, not a single-instrument specification.[15] |
| Price, TCO, market share, adoption, or procurement proof if making commercial claims | The ZNB3000 and ZNA67EXT sources state no price is provided, and Keysight PCB image sources do not support product specifications, price, supply status, customer adoption, shipment volume, or market share claims.[8][27][54] | LSmtron’s page states the source does not say whether LSmtron purchased, evaluated, ran a PoC, or was only a sales success story target.[37] |
### What can be safely said from current passages
The current evidence supports saying that R&S has formal VNA product specifications for ZNA, ZNB3000, ZNL, and ZNA67EXT, but comparisons must respect each document’s version, model scope, and product-data conditions.[4][5][22][68][72][96]
The current evidence supports saying that some semiconductor-adjacent applications are mentioned, including Bare Board for SoCs, AMD socket interconnection testing, and Samsung 5G SoC including VCO, but the sources explicitly list missing configuration and measurement details.[13][31][32][41][78]
The current evidence supports saying that the LSmtron case names Keysight ENA as a competitor and presents the R&S side as a total solution including ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but it does not provide ENA model/specs or a formal ZNB40 specification basis.[31][37][38][49]
### What not to claim yet
Do not claim R&S VNA is better than Keysight ENA/PNA for Semiconductor unless a cited source directly compares the specific R&S and Keysight configurations under the same DUT, calibration, de-embedding, and measurement conditions.[31][32][49][52]
Do not use the AMD “up to 67 GHz” stability statement as a standalone VNA specification, because the source lacks the complete topology, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding method, fixture, and DUT conditions.[32]
Do not use Keysight ENA or PNA product-family mentions to claim competitor performance, because the cited pages do not provide specific models, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration kits, TDR option names, or performance indicators.[49][52]
Do not present battle-card positioning such as “leadership,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” as technical specifications, because the cited comparison pages classify those as sales language and require official or third-party evidence for customer-facing competitor claims.[16][17][34]

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源有列出大量 options、accessories 與相依關係；本次 wiki 摘要保留主要可報價項目的 code、order no.、名稱與原文相依關係，但未逐字展開所有 calibration accessories、test cables、switch matrix extensions 的完整規格表。
- 部分表格同時出現 spec.、typ.、meas. 或 nom. 數值；本摘要依原文標示保留，不自行調和。
- 來源註明 Internal PC is subject to change without notice；因此 internal PC 規格需以此 Version 24.00（April 2026）為準。
- [[R&S ZNA-K121]] RF off boot up 在本次來源摘錄中列出名稱，但未提供 Order No.；頁面標示為來源未標示。
- 讀圖補充 p050 的尺寸數值旁單位無法辨識；不得推論為 mm 或其他單位。
- 本次輸入摘錄未提供讀圖頁面的圖片嵌入 wikilink，故 wiki 無法帶入原圖供核對。

R&S ZNA › 文件依據
- 來源：[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications。
- 文件編號：PD 5215.4652.22。

R&S ZNA
[[R&S ZNA]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Vector Network Analyzer 系列，依 Version 24.00（April 2026）規格書涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]]，頻率範圍從 10 MHz 延伸到最高 67 GHz。

R&S ZNA › R&S®ZNA-B15 RFFE GPIO interface 規格摘錄
- Models .02 and .03 提供 two independent MIPI RFFE busses。
- Connector type：25-pin D-Sub，female。
- RFFE port 1 / 2 的 VIO、DATA、CLK 電壓範圍為 0 V to +2 V，1 mV step，maximum current 20 mA。
- CLK configurable clock rate：31.25 kHz to 26 MHz。
- GPIO 1 to GPIO 8：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 20 mA。
- GPIO 9 and 10：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 100 mA。
- Model .03 提供 voltage and current measurement with switchable source resistance；32 internal ADC channels 可同時量測每個 RFFE 與 GPIO pin 的 voltage and current。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › p001（讀圖）
- 可見文字：R&S®ZNB3000、VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER、Specifications、Version 09.00、ROHDE&SCHWARZ、Make ideas real、ZNB Vector Network Analyzer。
- 頁面為文件封面樣式，主體是 R&S ZNB3000 VECTOR NETWORK ANALYZER 儀器照片。
- 儀器正面有大螢幕、右側實體按鍵與旋鈕、左右把手、前面板下方多個射頻連接埠。
- 螢幕顯示多個網路分析儀量測圖窗；圖表細部標示、座標數值與按鍵文字多數無法辨識。
- 可清楚辨識的數值只有 Version 09.00。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源萃取文字中，[[R&S ZNB3032]] dynamic range 小節標題寫作「with or without R&S®ZNB3-B322 / -B324」，但 ordering information 與 frequency range 小節列出 [[R&S ZNB3-B442]] / [[R&S ZNB3-B444]] 才是 ZNB3032 upgrade to 43.5 GHz。暫視為來源萃取或表頭錯位，報價與規格頁以 ordering information 明列代碼為準。
- 來源萃取文字中，[[R&S ZNB3044]] dynamic range 小節標題寫作「with or without R&S®ZNB3-B442 / -B444」，但 ordering information 與 frequency range 小節列出 [[R&S ZNB3-B542]] / [[R&S ZNB3-B544]] 才是 ZNB3044 upgrade to 54 GHz。暫視為來源萃取或表頭錯位，報價與規格頁以 ordering information 明列代碼為準。
- Power consumption 表格中有一組 2 ports max. 450 W, 145 W typ. / 4 ports max. 450 W, 200 W typ.，但型號在萃取文字中未清楚對應；本次不自行指派型號。
- 讀圖 p035 的尺寸圖可見多個數值，但圖上未清楚顯示尺寸單位；不將其覆蓋正文 dimensions。
- 來源未提供價格。

ZNB3000_specs_en_3647-5184-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- 所有 specification data 在 **+18 °C to +28 °C** 有效；measurement accuracy 另要求 calibration 後 temperature variation 不得超過 **1 °C**，且 measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須相同，不允許 interpolation。
- Measurement range：impedance 50 Ω；frequency resolution 1 Hz；number of measurement points per trace 1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit **1 Hz to 1 MHz**；搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-K17]] 10 MHz receiver bandwidth option 時為 **1 Hz to 10 MHz**。
- 型號與頻率範圍：[[R&S ZNB3004]] 為 9 kHz to 4.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B082]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B084]] 可到 9.0 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3020]] 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B262]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B264]] 可到 26.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3032]] 為 9 kHz to 32.0 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B442]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B444]] 可到 43.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNB3044]] 為 9 kHz to 43.5 GHz，搭配 [[R&S ZNB3-B542]] 或 [[R&S ZNB3-B544]] 可到 54.0 GHz。
- Dynamic range 規格以 10 Hz measurement bandwidth、without user correction applied 為條件；使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range；crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Measurement speed 以 firmware version 4.12 與 Windows 11 測得；來源註明 sweep time 應理解為 cycle time。
- General data：operating temperature +5 °C to +40 °C；storage temperature –20 °C to +60 °C；calibration interval 1 year；power supply 100 V to 240 V ±10 %，50 Hz to 60 Hz and 400 Hz，max. 3.5 A。
- Ordering information 列出 base units、frequency upgrade options、extended power range、receiver step attenuators、extended dynamic range、hardware options、software / measurement options、calibration accessories、power sensors、attenuators、switch matrices、test cables、hardware add-ons、warranty and service options。

ZNL_specs_en_3607-1071-22_v1000 › 重點摘要
- Product data 適用條件：於環境溫度下存放 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation；符合 specified environmental conditions；遵守 recommended calibration interval；已執行所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- 文件定義：Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表保證性能；non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證；uncertainties 以 coverage factor 2 並依 GUM 計算。
- 共通 VNA 量測：impedance 50 Ω；number of test ports 2；frequency resolution 1 Hz；number of measurement points per trace 1 to 100001；measurement bandwidth 1 Hz to 500 kHz，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 sequence。
- VNA frequency range：[[R&S ZNL3]] 為 5 kHz to 3 GHz；[[R&S ZNL4]] 為 5 kHz to 4.5 GHz；[[R&S ZNL6]] 為 5 kHz to 6 GHz；[[R&S ZNL14]] 為 5 kHz to 14 GHz；[[R&S ZNL20]] 為 5 kHz to 20 GHz。
- Test port connector：[[R&S ZNL3]]、[[R&S ZNL4]]、[[R&S ZNL6]]、[[R&S ZNL14]] 為 N, female；[[R&S ZNL20]] 為 3.5 mm, male。
- Dynamic range 規格條件：0 dBm source power 與 transmission magnitude data trace RMS value 的差；test ports short-circuited；10 Hz measurement bandwidth；without system error correction。使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Measurement accuracy 有效條件：+18 °C to +28 °C；calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C；依 port connector 使用 [[R&S ZV-Z270]] 或 [[R&S ZN-Z235]] calibration kit；TOSM/SOLT；measurement 與 calibration 的 frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 相同；不允許 interpolation。
- Spectrum analysis 為 option：[[R&S ZNL3-B1]]、[[R&S ZNL4-B1]]、[[R&S ZNL6-B1]]、[[R&S ZNL14-B1]]、[[R&S ZNL20-B1]]。搭配 spectrum analysis option 時，[[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 的 spectrum analysis frequency range 可到 26.5 GHz。

R&S ZNB3000 › Dynamic range 條件
- Receiver noise floor 定義為 transmission magnitude data trace 的 RMS 值，該 trace 由 noise 與 crosstalk 產生，test ports short-circuited。
- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。
- 使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Dynamic range performance 規格化於 port 1 與 port 2 之間，以及 4-port model 的 port 3 與 port 4 之間；其他 dynamic range performance 為 typical。
- Without enhanced dynamic range mode 時，above 100 kHz 的 nominal system dynamic range 會降低 15 dB to 20 dB；below 100 kHz 的影響可能更高。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？
7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？
8. Operators 或 certification bodies 是否要求 specific timeline 上的 validated NR-NTN conformance？
9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + WLAN + Fading + IP + NTN + RedCap**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system；對比 Keysight 需要 E7515P / E7515B / E7515E、E7515W、E7515R、RaySim / Channel Studio 與 additional tools。
- **FR2 / NTN Conformance Leadership**：主張 CMX500 有 50 GHz mmWave (RRH evo)、FR2 maturity、first validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance with Samsung、RedCap via OBT-Lite。
- **WLAN in Every Configuration**：主張 CMX500 可在每個 configuration 中整合 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling；對比 Keysight Wi-Fi 只在 E7515W 或 E7515P。
- **FR3 / 6G on One Platform**：主張 CMX500 可透過 [[RFU18]] 與 6G-relevant testing 演進，包含 AI-CSI feedback、satellite Doppler、NTN mobility、FR3 channel models；對比 Keysight multi-component approach。
- **Unified Automation**：將 CMsquares、CMsequencer、CONTEST、AI Script Assistant 定位為 one unified environment；對比 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、WLAN-specific tools、Nemo、UXM-specific application features。
- **Simplify the Message**：以 fewer boxes、fewer SKUs、more capability、lower TCO 作為 sales headline。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays

### Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, the evidence must directly connect the specific R&S VNA configuration, the specific competitor model/configuration, the semiconductor use case or customer context, and the measured performance under stated test conditions; the current passages show some semiconductor-adjacent VNA cases, but they also state many missing items such as competitor specs, R&S configuration details, DUT, calibration, fixture, probe, de-embedding workflow, and measurement conditions.[13][15][31][32][34][49][52]
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | What the passages currently show |
|---|---|---|
| Specific R&S VNA model, configuration, options, order numbers, and formal specification source | R&S VNA specifications must be taken from formal product specifications, and specifications/typical/measured values have different warranty status; non-traceable, typical, nominal, and measured values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz.[2][64][89] | Formal R&S VNA sources exist for ZNA, ZNB3000, ZNL, and ZNA67EXT, with document versions and frequency ranges identified.[4][5][22][68][96] |
| Specific competitor model and configuration, not only product-family names | The Keysight ENA and PNA pages state that the sources do not list specific model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option name, or performance indicators, so they do not support performance comparison claims.[49][52] | LSmtron is the only cited case that names a competitor, Keysight ENA, but it does not provide ENA model/configuration or performance data.[31][38][49] |
| Direct evidence connecting the comparison to a semiconductor use case | The case collection says it covers VNA/probe/mount-kit/de-embedding solutions for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation measurement problems, and the sales pattern is total solution rather than a single instrument specification.[14][15] | Semiconductor-adjacent cases include AMD socket interconnection, Bare Board for SoCs with Advantest/Meritech, and Samsung 5G SoC including VCO, but each has stated limitations.[13][31][32] |
| DUT, application, and measurement items | For Bare Board for SoCs, the source lists PCB test with probing and measurement of impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, but the source does not provide DUT specifications, frequency range, probe model, or de-embedding workflow.[42][41] | For LSmtron, the DUT is Board to Board Connector and the solution is ZNB40 with probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but the source does not provide a formal ZNB40 model page, order number, frequency range, or configuration.[38][37] |
| Complete test conditions: frequency range, fixture, probe, calibration, de-embedding, measurement bandwidth, sweep settings, and environmental conditions | Formal R&S product data and accuracy depend on warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, automatic adjustments, and in some cases identical calibration/measurement frequency points, bandwidth, and sweep time.[64][89][91] | The AMD 67 GHz stability claim lacks instrument combination, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding, fixture, and DUT conditions, so it cannot be used as a standalone ZNB3044 specification.[32] |
| Measured comparison data with metric name, unit, pass/fail threshold, and test conditions | Slide 3 in the TRI case only shows “< 5” without metric name, unit, test conditions, or pass/fail threshold, so it cannot support a comparison claim.[31][32] | ZNB3000 dynamic range conditions are specified as 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, but competitor performance data with equivalent conditions is not provided.[23] |
| Competitor evidence from official datasheets or third-party sources when making customer-facing claims | The Keysight-related limitations state that R&S battle-card claims need Keysight official data or third-party evidence for customer documents, and that battle cards do not replace formal specifications/features documents.[17][34] | The Keysight page says the CMX500 battle card lacks Keysight UXM official datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions; this illustrates the same evidence gap for competitor claims.[34] |
| Clear separation of sales positioning from verified technical specifications | The CMX500 vs Keysight page says the comparison is sales positioning, not binding technical specifications, and “only platform,” “first validated,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” are sales language rather than verified technical specifications.[16][17] | For VNA cases, the stated win factor is total solution with probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, not a single-instrument specification.[15] |
| Price, TCO, market share, adoption, or procurement proof if making commercial claims | The ZNB3000 and ZNA67EXT sources state no price is provided, and Keysight PCB image sources do not support product specifications, price, supply status, customer adoption, shipment volume, or market share claims.[8][27][54] | LSmtron’s page states the source does not say whether LSmtron purchased, evaluated, ran a PoC, or was only a sales success story target.[37] |
### What can be safely said from current passages
The current evidence supports saying that R&S has formal VNA product specifications for ZNA, ZNB3000, ZNL, and ZNA67EXT, but comparisons must respect each document’s version, model scope, and product-data conditions.[4][5][22][68][72][96]
The current evidence supports saying that some semiconductor-adjacent applications are mentioned, including Bare Board for SoCs, AMD socket interconnection testing, and Samsung 5G SoC including VCO, but the sources explicitly list missing configuration and measurement details.[13][31][32][41][78]
The current evidence supports saying that the LSmtron case names Keysight ENA as a competitor and presents the R&S side as a total solution including ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but it does not provide ENA model/specs or a formal ZNB40 specification basis.[31][37][38][49]
### What not to claim yet
Do not claim R&S VNA is better than Keysight ENA/PNA for Semiconductor unless a cited source directly compares the specific R&S and Keysight configurations under the same DUT, calibration, de-embedding, and measurement conditions.[31][32][49][52]
Do not use the AMD “up to 67 GHz” stability statement as a standalone VNA specification, because the source lacks the complete topology, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding method, fixture, and DUT conditions.[32]
Do not use Keysight ENA or PNA product-family mentions to claim competitor performance, because the cited pages do not provide specific models, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration kits, TDR option names, or performance indicators.[49][52]
Do not present battle-card positioning such as “leadership,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” as technical specifications, because the cited comparison pages classify those as sales language and require official or third-party evidence for customer-facing competitor claims.[16][17][34]

- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S ZNB3000 › Dynamic range 條件
- Receiver noise floor 定義為 transmission magnitude data trace 的 RMS 值，該 trace 由 noise 與 crosstalk 產生，test ports short-circuited。
- Specifications 適用於 10 Hz measurement bandwidth，without user correction applied。
- 使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。
- Crosstalk does not limit dynamic range。
- Dynamic range performance 規格化於 port 1 與 port 2 之間，以及 4-port model 的 port 3 與 port 4 之間；其他 dynamic range performance 為 typical。
- Without enhanced dynamic range mode 時，above 100 kHz 的 nominal system dynamic range 會降低 15 dB to 20 dB；below 100 kHz 的影響可能更高。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？
7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？
8. Operators 或 certification bodies 是否要求 specific timeline 上的 validated NR-NTN conformance？
9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + WLAN + Fading + IP + NTN + RedCap**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 unified system；對比 Keysight 需要 E7515P / E7515B / E7515E、E7515W、E7515R、RaySim / Channel Studio 與 additional tools。
- **FR2 / NTN Conformance Leadership**：主張 CMX500 有 50 GHz mmWave (RRH evo)、FR2 maturity、first validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance with Samsung、RedCap via OBT-Lite。
- **WLAN in Every Configuration**：主張 CMX500 可在每個 configuration 中整合 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling；對比 Keysight Wi-Fi 只在 E7515W 或 E7515P。
- **FR3 / 6G on One Platform**：主張 CMX500 可透過 [[RFU18]] 與 6G-relevant testing 演進，包含 AI-CSI feedback、satellite Doppler、NTN mobility、FR3 channel models；對比 Keysight multi-component approach。
- **Unified Automation**：將 CMsquares、CMsequencer、CONTEST、AI Script Assistant 定位為 one unified environment；對比 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、WLAN-specific tools、Nemo、UXM-specific application features。
- **Simplify the Message**：以 fewer boxes、fewer SKUs、more capability、lower TCO 作為 sales headline。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 FR1 bandwidth beyond 400 MHz，例如 600–800 MHz per carrier for 5G-Advanced Rel-18 / Rel-19 testing？
2. 是否需要 FR1、FR2、FR3、WLAN 與 LTE 在 single instrument 中且不用 hardware swaps？
3. 是否需要 native fading with high-throughput IP testing？
4. 是否偏好 one unified software platform，而不是 four separate tools？
5. 是否需要 advanced CA 或 mobility without adding extra boxes？
6. 是否需要 FR3 testing beyond 16 GHz，以支援 emerging 6G FR3 evaluations？

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu › R&S offensive plays

### Short answer
To compare our Vector Network Analyzer solution with a Semiconductor competitor without unsupported claims, the evidence must directly connect the specific R&S VNA configuration, the specific competitor model/configuration, the semiconductor use case or customer context, and the measured performance under stated test conditions; the current passages show some semiconductor-adjacent VNA cases, but they also state many missing items such as competitor specs, R&S configuration details, DUT, calibration, fixture, probe, de-embedding workflow, and measurement conditions.[13][15][31][32][34][49][52]
### Evidence required
| Required evidence | Why it is required | What the passages currently show |
|---|---|---|
| Specific R&S VNA model, configuration, options, order numbers, and formal specification source | R&S VNA specifications must be taken from formal product specifications, and specifications/typical/measured values have different warranty status; non-traceable, typical, nominal, and measured values are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz.[2][64][89] | Formal R&S VNA sources exist for ZNA, ZNB3000, ZNL, and ZNA67EXT, with document versions and frequency ranges identified.[4][5][22][68][96] |
| Specific competitor model and configuration, not only product-family names | The Keysight ENA and PNA pages state that the sources do not list specific model, frequency range, option code, calibration kit, TDR option name, or performance indicators, so they do not support performance comparison claims.[49][52] | LSmtron is the only cited case that names a competitor, Keysight ENA, but it does not provide ENA model/configuration or performance data.[31][38][49] |
| Direct evidence connecting the comparison to a semiconductor use case | The case collection says it covers VNA/probe/mount-kit/de-embedding solutions for PCB, socket, connector, and SoC validation measurement problems, and the sales pattern is total solution rather than a single instrument specification.[14][15] | Semiconductor-adjacent cases include AMD socket interconnection, Bare Board for SoCs with Advantest/Meritech, and Samsung 5G SoC including VCO, but each has stated limitations.[13][31][32] |
| DUT, application, and measurement items | For Bare Board for SoCs, the source lists PCB test with probing and measurement of impedance, insertion loss, and return loss, but the source does not provide DUT specifications, frequency range, probe model, or de-embedding workflow.[42][41] | For LSmtron, the DUT is Board to Board Connector and the solution is ZNB40 with probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but the source does not provide a formal ZNB40 model page, order number, frequency range, or configuration.[38][37] |
| Complete test conditions: frequency range, fixture, probe, calibration, de-embedding, measurement bandwidth, sweep settings, and environmental conditions | Formal R&S product data and accuracy depend on warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, automatic adjustments, and in some cases identical calibration/measurement frequency points, bandwidth, and sweep time.[64][89][91] | The AMD 67 GHz stability claim lacks instrument combination, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding, fixture, and DUT conditions, so it cannot be used as a standalone ZNB3044 specification.[32] |
| Measured comparison data with metric name, unit, pass/fail threshold, and test conditions | Slide 3 in the TRI case only shows “< 5” without metric name, unit, test conditions, or pass/fail threshold, so it cannot support a comparison claim.[31][32] | ZNB3000 dynamic range conditions are specified as 10 Hz measurement bandwidth without user correction, but competitor performance data with equivalent conditions is not provided.[23] |
| Competitor evidence from official datasheets or third-party sources when making customer-facing claims | The Keysight-related limitations state that R&S battle-card claims need Keysight official data or third-party evidence for customer documents, and that battle cards do not replace formal specifications/features documents.[17][34] | The Keysight page says the CMX500 battle card lacks Keysight UXM official datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions; this illustrates the same evidence gap for competitor claims.[34] |
| Clear separation of sales positioning from verified technical specifications | The CMX500 vs Keysight page says the comparison is sales positioning, not binding technical specifications, and “only platform,” “first validated,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” are sales language rather than verified technical specifications.[16][17] | For VNA cases, the stated win factor is total solution with probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, not a single-instrument specification.[15] |
| Price, TCO, market share, adoption, or procurement proof if making commercial claims | The ZNB3000 and ZNA67EXT sources state no price is provided, and Keysight PCB image sources do not support product specifications, price, supply status, customer adoption, shipment volume, or market share claims.[8][27][54] | LSmtron’s page states the source does not say whether LSmtron purchased, evaluated, ran a PoC, or was only a sales success story target.[37] |
### What can be safely said from current passages
The current evidence supports saying that R&S has formal VNA product specifications for ZNA, ZNB3000, ZNL, and ZNA67EXT, but comparisons must respect each document’s version, model scope, and product-data conditions.[4][5][22][68][72][96]
The current evidence supports saying that some semiconductor-adjacent applications are mentioned, including Bare Board for SoCs, AMD socket interconnection testing, and Samsung 5G SoC including VCO, but the sources explicitly list missing configuration and measurement details.[13][31][32][41][78]
The current evidence supports saying that the LSmtron case names Keysight ENA as a competitor and presents the R&S side as a total solution including ZNB40, probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool, and local partner, but it does not provide ENA model/specs or a formal ZNB40 specification basis.[31][37][38][49]
### What not to claim yet
Do not claim R&S VNA is better than Keysight ENA/PNA for Semiconductor unless a cited source directly compares the specific R&S and Keysight configurations under the same DUT, calibration, de-embedding, and measurement conditions.[31][32][49][52]
Do not use the AMD “up to 67 GHz” stability statement as a standalone VNA specification, because the source lacks the complete topology, extender, probe, calibration, de-embedding method, fixture, and DUT conditions.[32]
Do not use Keysight ENA or PNA product-family mentions to claim competitor performance, because the cited pages do not provide specific models, option codes, frequency ranges, calibration kits, TDR option names, or performance indicators.[49][52]
Do not present battle-card positioning such as “leadership,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” as technical specifications, because the cited comparison pages classify those as sales language and require official or third-party evidence for customer-facing competitor claims.[16][17][34]

- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
